summary: Diagnosed and fixed a CI/CD deploy failure caused by a race condition between manual docker rm -f and docker compose up -d trying to stop the same container by internal ID. Cleared the ghost container from Docker's data root and re-deployed cleanly.
highlights: Fixed deploy-backend.yml: manual docker rm -f hisab-backend was removing the container by name, then docker compose up tried to stop the same container by its internal ID — already gone, causing 'No such container' crash; removed the redundant rm -f since compose handles its own recreation

Ghost container cleanup: deleted stale container directory from Docker data root at /mnt/hermes_drive/0_DATA/docker/containers/<id>, restarted Docker daemon to flush state, then re-ran deploy — both build and deploy jobs passed clean
